BackstoryDef.title: hive whelp
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised in the warm dark near the chaurus pens, fighting siblings for food. [PAWN_pronoun] had learned before anything else to identify every creature in the hive by the sound of its feet.

BackstoryDef.title: egg tender
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent childhood turning chaurus eggs in the warm sacs of the lower hive and fetching them whatever they ate. It bred a strong stomach, and very little else.

BackstoryDef.title: ruin scavenger
BackstoryDef.description: The old machines still hum in the walls, and [PAWN_nameDef] crept through them by touch, stripping metal for blades. Twice a centurion woke up. Twice [PAWN_pronoun] heard it first.

BackstoryDef.title: skulker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] went out on many surface raids, waiting in the snow until someone walked close enough. The hive has eaten well because of it.

BackstoryDef.title: bone-bow stalker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] looses arrows at heartbeats and footfalls in the dark, and misses less often than those on the receiving end would like. Poison handles the rest.

BackstoryDef.title: pen keeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] drove chaurus for the hive, herding them with sharp clicks and a pointed stick. It takes a certain kind of person, and that person is seldom missed by anyone.

BackstoryDef.title: fungus gatherer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent years in the Blackreach caverns, picking through glowing fungus by touch and smell. The glow itself was never of any use to [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: hive shaman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] keeps what is left of the old rites, which amounts to some cold magic, a sequence of sounds, and the job of deciding who gets fed to what.

BackstoryDef.title: Forgotten Vale wanderer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] once wandered too far and found stone halls under open sky, with a wayshrine that hummed faintly. Something there remembered [PAWN_possessive] people's true name. [PAWN_pronoun] left quickly and has been unsettled ever since.

BackstoryDef.title: blind-born
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] came into the world with no eyes to speak of, like everyone [PAWN_pronoun] knew. It would be years before the word for sight meant anything, and it never meant much.

BackstoryDef.title: feast scrap
BackstoryDef.description: After raids the hive's young fought over whatever the warriors left. [PAWN_nameDef] came out of those fights with most of [PAWN_possessive] teeth.

BackstoryDef.title: wall listener
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was placed against the cold stone with one ear flat, reporting every far-off footfall. The wall was the only teacher [PAWN_pronoun] ever needed.

BackstoryDef.title: thrall-born
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s mother was taken from the surface and did not live long. The hive never told [PAWN_objective] about her, and did not know the words to.

BackstoryDef.title: chitin gatherer
BackstoryDef.description: Falmer huts are built from what chaurus shed. [PAWN_nameDef] dragged the plates through the tunnels as soon as [PAWN_pronoun] was strong enough.

BackstoryDef.title: Blackreach stray
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] got separated in Blackreach for most of a season and came back fat. Nobody asked what [PAWN_pronoun] had been eating, since nobody there could ask anything.

BackstoryDef.title: captive taker
BackstoryDef.description: Dragging a living Nord through a mile of tunnel takes more skill than killing one. [PAWN_nameDef] has done it more times than the hive can count, because the hive can't count.

BackstoryDef.title: warmonger's shadow
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] followed a warmonger through a dozen raids, two paces behind and to the left, close enough to hear the breathing change.

BackstoryDef.title: poison maker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] prepared arrow venom from chaurus glands, tasting each batch to check it. Over the years [PAWN_pronoun] has become rather hard to poison.

BackstoryDef.title: tunnel ambusher
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has ruined several Dwemer ruin expeditions. They carry torches and talk constantly, which [PAWN_pronoun] has always been grateful for.

BackstoryDef.title: surface raider
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] came up through the ice at night to take sheep and shepherds alike. The cold, at least, felt like home.

BackstoryDef.title: scrap smith
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] beats scavenged bronze into jagged swords by feel, working from memory of what a good edge sounds like.

BackstoryDef.title: hive builder
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] raised shell huts across a cavern floor, working by touch and echo. They look awful and have lasted a very long time.

BackstoryDef.title: cistern keeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] looked after the dripping Dwemer pipes the hive drank from, without any idea of who laid them or why.

BackstoryDef.title: larder keeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept the hive's meat cold, sorted by how long it had stopped screaming.

BackstoryDef.title: cave digger
BackstoryDef.description: With blunt picks stolen from old mines, [PAWN_nameDef] opened new tunnels toward any noise that sounded like food.

BackstoryDef.title: cold speaker
BackstoryDef.description: Long sequences of clicks and hisses are all that remain of the Snow Elves' hymns. [PAWN_nameDef] performs them perfectly, and has no notion what they say.

BackstoryDef.title: frost reader
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] feels the ice with [PAWN_possessive] palms and tells the raiders when to go. It is right about the weather a little more often than chance.

BackstoryDef.title: rite butcher
BackstoryDef.description: Somebody decides which captive goes to which chaurus, and how. [PAWN_nameDef] does this with what the hive understands to be reverence.

BackstoryDef.title: hollow oracle
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] sits in a side cavern and answers questions in the long hiss. Warmongers come to [PAWN_objective] before raids, and sometimes kill [PAWN_objective] successors after them.

BackstoryDef.title: chaurus nest crawler
BackstoryDef.description: Only a very small body fits in the egg chambers, so [PAWN_nameDef] was sent in. Young chaurus learned the scent and mostly left the child alone.

BackstoryDef.title: fungus bed child
BackstoryDef.description: Pale growths along the wet walls feed most of a hive. [PAWN_nameDef] knew them all by touch and got slapped for eating the seed caps.

BackstoryDef.title: blind pup
BackstoryDef.description: Falmer children do not know that they are missing anything. [PAWN_nameDef] ran through dark tunnels at full speed, tracing the walls with one hand.

BackstoryDef.title: echo-clicker
BackstoryDef.description: A tongue click returns off stone differently than it does off flesh. [PAWN_nameDef] played this game with other children until it stopped being a game.

BackstoryDef.title: skull-gnawer
BackstoryDef.description: What the adults left of a raid went to the young. [PAWN_nameDef] grew strong on it and learned where the marrow hides.

BackstoryDef.title: pit-born
BackstoryDef.description: Weak children go down the pit, and the strong climb out. [PAWN_nameDef] climbed out on the second try, with someone else's ear in hand.

BackstoryDef.title: Sunderstone child
BackstoryDef.description: Sunderstone Gorge's waters roar through the rock so loud that nobody can hear hunting. [PAWN_nameDef] learned to feel footsteps through the soles of the feet instead.

BackstoryDef.title: Darkfall stray
BackstoryDef.description: Somewhere beneath Darkfall the tribes meet and fight, and the losers leave children behind. [PAWN_nameDef] was found in a side passage and fed for no clear reason.

BackstoryDef.title: Alftand tunnel child
BackstoryDef.description: Old metal lies all over the halls below Alftand. [PAWN_nameDef] pried it up with bare fingers and brought it to the smiths, for scraps.

BackstoryDef.title: Mzulft scrap-runner
BackstoryDef.description: Machines still move in Mzulft, and they don't care who was there first. [PAWN_nameDef] ran between them with a bag of gears, hearing them turn.

BackstoryDef.title: Blackreach-born
BackstoryDef.description: Blackreach is vast enough that the echoes do not come back. [PAWN_nameDef] was one of the few born there who liked the feeling.

BackstoryDef.title: chaurus milk stealer
BackstoryDef.description: Chaurus give off a sour fluid that the hive makes into something like food. [PAWN_nameDef] stole it from the pens and had the acid scars to prove it.

BackstoryDef.title: bat catcher
BackstoryDef.description: Bats make very good eating and hear better than any Falmer. [PAWN_nameDef] spent years learning to wait until one forgot.

BackstoryDef.title: shaman's stool-bearer
BackstoryDef.description: Shamans need somebody to fetch and hold things, including their temper. [PAWN_nameDef] carried a bone stool and overheard a great deal about who would die next.

BackstoryDef.title: thrall-pen child
BackstoryDef.description: Some children were born among the prisoners, and nobody asked whose. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up hauling stones with the captured Nords and picked up a little of their speech.

BackstoryDef.title: spider-web gatherer
BackstoryDef.description: Frostbite spiders leave their old webs behind if you are patient. [PAWN_nameDef] brought armfuls home, and the armor makers used them to bind chitin.

BackstoryDef.title: venom sac carrier
BackstoryDef.description: Chaurus venom has to be moved carefully from the pens to the bowmakers. [PAWN_nameDef] dropped only one sac and has been missing a patch of skin since.

BackstoryDef.title: surface-burned child
BackstoryDef.description: Sunlight has no meaning to the blind, but they know heat on the skin. [PAWN_nameDef] went too far up an ice shaft one day and came back with a blistered face.

BackstoryDef.title: ice-melt fetcher
BackstoryDef.description: Water drips clean from high cracks where the glacier sits on the rock. [PAWN_nameDef] climbed up with a skin bag each day and was seldom thanked.

BackstoryDef.title: war-drum child
BackstoryDef.description: Beats on a stretched hide carry for miles under stone. As the youngest in the band, [PAWN_nameDef] drummed the signal when the hive was on the move.

BackstoryDef.title: chitin scraper
BackstoryDef.description: Molted shells must be scraped clean before use. [PAWN_nameDef] did this for days on end, in a stench that only other Falmer could enjoy.

BackstoryDef.title: tunnel-sealer
BackstoryDef.description: Dead passages get walled up with stones and resin. [PAWN_nameDef] had the small hands needed to push the last stones in from the proper side.

BackstoryDef.title: lost from the raiders
BackstoryDef.description: A raid on a Nord farmstead came home one Falmer short. The small one left behind, [PAWN_nameDef], followed the smell back to the cave after three nights outside.

BackstoryDef.title: scent-marker
BackstoryDef.description: Tunnels are marked by smell for those who know the code. [PAWN_nameDef] learned these marks at the age when others learned to fight.

BackstoryDef.title: deep crawler's whelp
BackstoryDef.description: Some Falmer never come up from the lowest levels, and some children never see the top. [PAWN_nameDef] thought the deep tunnels were all of the world.

BackstoryDef.title: gut-reader's helper
BackstoryDef.description: Shamans read fortune in fresh entrails, and someone has to hold the bowl. [PAWN_nameDef] learned how bodies fit together from that bowl and came to know them well.

BackstoryDef.title: captive's pet
BackstoryDef.description: A Nord prisoner, far gone in the head, spoke kindly to the child who brought her food. [PAWN_nameDef] copied the sounds, without any idea what they meant.

BackstoryDef.title: rat-pit fighter
BackstoryDef.description: Elder Falmer set the children on skeevers and bet food on the outcome. [PAWN_nameDef] got a reputation, and a good deal more to eat than most.

BackstoryDef.title: moss eater
BackstoryDef.description: Bad winters empty the pens, and the young get whatever's left on the walls. [PAWN_nameDef] survived one on moss, and the taste still lingers.

BackstoryDef.title: bone-whistle maker
BackstoryDef.description: Certain pitches send chaurus to the pens and others bring them out. [PAWN_nameDef] cut whistles out of finger bones and tested them, with some close calls.

BackstoryDef.title: ember-keeper
BackstoryDef.description: Fire is not much use to the blind except for warmth and meat, but a hive keeps one. [PAWN_nameDef] fed it and knew how it sounded when it was close to dying.

BackstoryDef.title: rock-listener
BackstoryDef.description: Pressing a cheek to the rock tells who's coming from which direction. [PAWN_nameDef] did this at the cave mouth and gave warning with a low hiss.

BackstoryDef.title: snow-crust scavenger
BackstoryDef.description: Above the hive, frozen birds and hares turn up in the snow after storms. [PAWN_nameDef] went out by night and felt for them under the crust.

BackstoryDef.title: hive twin
BackstoryDef.description: Two came out alive at the same birth, and only one would be raised. [PAWN_nameDef] was the one that bit first, and everyone in the hive knows the tale.

BackstoryDef.title: fire-shy child
BackstoryDef.description: A torch thrown down the shaft by Nord raiders took half the nursery. [PAWN_nameDef] came through with burned hands and a fine sense of where the air was moving.

BackstoryDef.title: old stair child
BackstoryDef.description: The stairs in the old part of the hive were cut by Snow Elves or maybe by Dwemer, and no one remembers. [PAWN_nameDef] knew each worn place in them by foot.

BackstoryDef.title: bowstring chewer
BackstoryDef.description: Sinew has to be softened somehow. [PAWN_nameDef] chewed it into bowstrings from morning to night and lost several teeth in the service of the hive.

BackstoryDef.title: captive-feeder
BackstoryDef.description: Prisoners that starve are a waste of good meat and good labor. [PAWN_nameDef] went from cage to cage with a bowl and got bitten only sometimes.

BackstoryDef.title: shaft-dropper
BackstoryDef.description: Stones can be dropped on enemies from above, if you know where they're walking. [PAWN_nameDef] sat over the main shaft and listened for days on end.

BackstoryDef.title: wandering hive's child
BackstoryDef.description: When a Dwemer machine broke through the home tunnels, the whole hive moved. [PAWN_nameDef] remembers little but walking in the dark while holding someone's heel.

BackstoryDef.title: eggshell cup maker
BackstoryDef.description: Chaurus eggshells are tough and hold liquid well. [PAWN_nameDef] broke them clean and made cups used for water, venom and, in a pinch, a ritual.

BackstoryDef.title: chaurus war-handler
BackstoryDef.description: A hive goes to war with its beasts in front. [PAWN_nameDef] walked behind them with a long goad, and knew the moment they'd turn around.

BackstoryDef.title: gloomlurker
BackstoryDef.description: Gloomlurkers kill in places with no room to swing. [PAWN_nameDef] spent long years pressed flat in a crack in the rock, waiting for warm breath.

BackstoryDef.title: shadowmaster
BackstoryDef.description: Few are ever given the shadowmaster's rank, and it's taken back only one way. [PAWN_nameDef] has kept it through more than a dozen challenges.

BackstoryDef.title: warmonger's bow
BackstoryDef.description: Falmer archers shoot at sound, and they're seldom wrong. [PAWN_nameDef] tracked a Nord by his breathing across a whole cavern and put an arrow through it.

BackstoryDef.title: blackblade
BackstoryDef.description: Chitin edges break, but they cut very deep before they do. [PAWN_nameDef] made a set of curved ones and carried them into the fighting in the old halls.

BackstoryDef.title: poison-arrow hunter
BackstoryDef.description: There's a lot of venom in one chaurus, and it goes a long way on an arrow. [PAWN_nameDef] seldom had to shoot anything twice.

BackstoryDef.title: ice-shaft sentry
BackstoryDef.description: Cold comes down the shaft first, followed by whoever's coming. [PAWN_nameDef] stood in that draft for years, listening to the snow.

BackstoryDef.title: Nord-taker
BackstoryDef.description: Nord farms give a good haul of meat and captive hands. [PAWN_nameDef] led the night raids and knew how to pull someone out of bed without waking the dog.

BackstoryDef.title: Dwemer-machine breaker
BackstoryDef.description: Old grudges run down the bloodline, even when memory doesn't. [PAWN_nameDef] goes after the walking bronze things wherever they turn up, and takes them apart.

BackstoryDef.title: tunnel-war veteran
BackstoryDef.description: Hive against hive is the worst kind of fighting, with both sides as blind as each other. [PAWN_nameDef] came out of the Blackreach wars with one working ear.

BackstoryDef.title: cave-mouth ambusher
BackstoryDef.description: Adventurers have a bad habit of walking in with torches. [PAWN_nameDef] stayed behind them and listened as they talked about treasure and then stopped.

BackstoryDef.title: trap setter
BackstoryDef.description: Spikes, bone chimes and a tripline at ankle height will do for most people. [PAWN_nameDef] rigs every approach to the hive, and walks them daily in bare feet.

BackstoryDef.title: gut-hook fighter
BackstoryDef.description: A bent hook goes into the belly easily and comes out with more. [PAWN_nameDef] preferred it for that reason, and was given a wide berth at meals.

BackstoryDef.title: night stalker of the Reach
BackstoryDef.description: Up in the Reach, the Forsworn and Falmer hunt the same nights. [PAWN_nameDef] came up out of the ground often enough to learn the difference.

BackstoryDef.title: screamer
BackstoryDef.description: Certain cries in a tunnel will pass for a dozen voices. [PAWN_nameDef] used them to scare enemy bands into running blindly the wrong way.

BackstoryDef.title: elder's right hand
BackstoryDef.description: An elder needs someone standing close who'll take a knife meant for them. [PAWN_nameDef] has taken three so far and lived, which helped [PAWN_possessive] standing.

BackstoryDef.title: snow raider
BackstoryDef.description: Few Falmer will walk the open mountains, since wind eats sound. [PAWN_nameDef] goes anyway, wrapped in stolen wool and following the slope.

BackstoryDef.title: chitin armorer of war
BackstoryDef.description: Armor from chaurus plate has to be fitted by touch. [PAWN_nameDef] made all that the band wore and fought in the front rank to see how it held up.

BackstoryDef.title: frost shaman
BackstoryDef.description: Cold comes when called, as it's never very far off in Skyrim's caves. [PAWN_nameDef] called it down on a thane's son and was given his sword for a staff.

BackstoryDef.title: fire shaman
BackstoryDef.description: Flame means little to the eyeless but they fear it anyway. [PAWN_nameDef] learned its heat from the outside in and throws it by sound.

BackstoryDef.title: bone-scryer
BackstoryDef.description: Cast finger bones speak in the rattle they make. [PAWN_nameDef] heard the coming of three raids and one great hunger that way, or claims to have.

BackstoryDef.title: ancient name keeper
BackstoryDef.description: A few sounds, passed down, may once have been names of Snow Elf kings. [PAWN_nameDef] chants them in order, with no notion of who they were.

BackstoryDef.title: chaurus speaker
BackstoryDef.description: Certain shamans can settle the pens with a low sound in the throat. [PAWN_nameDef] sat with the breeding queen for days and walked away from it unbitten.

BackstoryDef.title: wound-sealer
BackstoryDef.description: Hot resin, a sharp bone and a firm hand can do a lot. [PAWN_nameDef] works by feel and keeps more fighters alive than the Nords would believe possible.

BackstoryDef.title: elder of the dark rite
BackstoryDef.description: Prisoners are bled at certain times, and the reason's been lost, except that the elders must keep doing it. [PAWN_nameDef] keeps doing it.

BackstoryDef.title: lightning-touched shaman
BackstoryDef.description: Storms reach down the upper shafts sometimes, and some shamans are said to catch one. [PAWN_nameDef] has done it twice and has a tremor in one hand.

BackstoryDef.title: prophet of the Betrayed
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] tells the hive it was wronged long ago, and that the wrong will be repaid. It doesn't matter that no one recalls by whom.

BackstoryDef.title: mind-sickener
BackstoryDef.description: Some shamans know how to make a captive see things and not trust what they see. [PAWN_nameDef] learned on the Nords and gets better results each year.

BackstoryDef.title: hive midwife
BackstoryDef.description: Births are hard in a cold cave, and [PAWN_nameDef] oversees them all, deciding which children get the first feeding. No one questions these decisions.

BackstoryDef.title: ruin-oracle
BackstoryDef.description: Hands on an old Dwemer door can pick up a hum in the metal. [PAWN_nameDef] sits by one for hours and passes on what it's saying, which is usually bad.

BackstoryDef.title: poison shaman
BackstoryDef.description: Spider, chaurus and a certain blue cave lichen all kill differently. [PAWN_nameDef] knows the order to mix them in, and has outlived several rivals because of it.

BackstoryDef.title: ice-breath caller
BackstoryDef.description: Breathing out slowly, [PAWN_nameDef] lets the frost run along the arm and off the fingers. No one else in the hive has learned how to do it without losing a hand.

BackstoryDef.title: keeper of eggs
BackstoryDef.description: Eggs that fail must be pulled out fast, before the rest take sick. [PAWN_nameDef] goes along the rows at each feeding, feeling for the cold ones.

BackstoryDef.title: fungal seer
BackstoryDef.description: A certain mushroom opens the throat and loosens the wits. [PAWN_nameDef] eats it on the proper nights and tells the elders where to raid.

BackstoryDef.title: whisperer of the Vale
BackstoryDef.description: Stories in the hive say there's a place above where the snow is warm and the old ones still sing. [PAWN_nameDef] went looking for it, and came back alone and strange.

BackstoryDef.title: chaurus butcher
BackstoryDef.description: Every part of a chaurus has a use if you can get to it before the venom sets. [PAWN_nameDef] splits them with a single stroke, by long practice and smell.

BackstoryDef.title: resin boiler
BackstoryDef.description: Tree sap traded or stolen from the surface goes in a pot with chitin. [PAWN_nameDef] sits in the fumes and turns out the glue that holds the hive's gear together.

BackstoryDef.title: fungal farmer
BackstoryDef.description: Rows of soft caps in the dark don't look like much, but they feed a hive through winter. [PAWN_nameDef] walks them each day with fingers trailing along the beds.

BackstoryDef.title: tunnel widener
BackstoryDef.description: An old passage can always be made wider with enough bone picks. [PAWN_nameDef] has dug through more stone than most Dwemer, without any of the arithmetic.

BackstoryDef.title: thrall driver
BackstoryDef.description: Prisoners haul the stone, and someone has to make them keep at it. [PAWN_nameDef] walks behind them and can tell by their breathing who's about to fall.

BackstoryDef.title: skin curer
BackstoryDef.description: All sorts of hides come in, and some of them are people. [PAWN_nameDef] stretches each one on a frame and is not fussy about where it started out.

BackstoryDef.title: scrap trader
BackstoryDef.description: Hives will sometimes trade if they're starving, and someone must stand between the two sides. [PAWN_nameDef] is still alive after doing this several times.

BackstoryDef.title: cave-pool fisher
BackstoryDef.description: Pale fish in a deep pool can be taken with a hand, if one is very patient. [PAWN_nameDef] stands for hours in icy water up to the waist and hears them come.

BackstoryDef.title: ice cutter
BackstoryDef.description: Glacier ice stores meat for a long time and also seals a tunnel well. [PAWN_nameDef] cuts blocks from the upper shafts and drags them down on a hide sled.

BackstoryDef.title: bone sorter
BackstoryDef.description: After a feast, all the bones go into separate heaps for needles, tools and arrows. [PAWN_nameDef] sorts them by feel and knows at once which belonged to whom.

BackstoryDef.title: smoke keeper
BackstoryDef.description: Meat keeps longer over a slow fire, and a slow fire has to be watched. [PAWN_nameDef] lives in the smoke-chamber and comes out coughing only to eat.

BackstoryDef.title: hive-wall mender
BackstoryDef.description: Mud walls and woven web crack with the cold. [PAWN_nameDef] goes around every chamber after the thaw, feeling for the drafts and plugging them.

BackstoryDef.title: prisoner keeper
BackstoryDef.description: Cages have to be watched, and their contents kept alive for as long as they're wanted. [PAWN_nameDef] is good at this, in a manner that captives do not appreciate.

BackstoryDef.title: bat-guano digger
BackstoryDef.description: Fungus beds need feeding, and the old caves are full of what they need. [PAWN_nameDef] digs it up by the basket, and the rest of the hive keeps a respectful distance.

BackstoryDef.title: lantern-bug herder
BackstoryDef.description: Glowing bugs are of no use to the blind, except that captives work better if they can see. [PAWN_nameDef] keeps them in the pens and doesn't know what they're for.

BackstoryDef.title: tool knapper
BackstoryDef.description: Rock and chitin both flake along hidden lines. [PAWN_nameDef] can hear these lines with a light tap and doesn't waste a single good stone.

BackstoryDef.title: snow-melt carrier
BackstoryDef.description: A hive drinks a great deal, and all of it has to be carried. [PAWN_nameDef] has walked one route for years and worn a groove in the passage's floor.

BackstoryDef.title: ration divider
BackstoryDef.description: Each share of food has to be measured out fairly or there's blood. [PAWN_nameDef] does it with a bone scoop, and has never once been caught cheating.

BackstoryDef.title: cloth stealer
BackstoryDef.description: Wool can't be grown underground, so someone's got to go get it. [PAWN_nameDef] returned from Nord farmhouses with blankets, shirts and the occasional live sheep.

BackstoryDef.title: deep digger
BackstoryDef.description: Below the lowest hall, there's another one, and [PAWN_nameDef] is looking for it. Nobody ordered this. Elders have stopped asking and just send food down.

BackstoryDef.title: chaurus egg trader
BackstoryDef.description: Fresh eggs buy peace between neighboring hives for about a season. [PAWN_nameDef] carries them across the dead ground in a padded sling, moving slowly and clicking often.
